articles.title: Building the View: 4 Brazilian Houses Framing the Sea
articles.summary: Throughout history, people have sought ways to see the world. In Renaissance painting , linear perspective made this impulse explicit by transforming the canvas into a window , organizing depth from a fixed viewpoint. In his treatise De Pictura (1435), Leon Battista Alberti described painting as a window onto what one wishes to represent. Landscape , in this sense, ceased to be simply what lay before the eyes and became a visual construction, a reality selected and organized by the gaze.

articles.title: Mornington House / Foomann Architects
articles.summary: Mornington House is our clients' holiday home. It sits on the same block as an older holiday home, occupied by their adult children and families, and shares a swimming pool and driveway. The couple engaged Foomann to design a relaxed house that focuses on the view, where they can host guests and entertain.

articles.title: House in Mibu / Tato Architects
articles.summary: Through architecture, we inevitably alter the environment. Yet we are always asking whether that act of alteration might avoid damaging its surroundings, whether it might instead change them in a way that heals.

articles.title: How Material Choices Shape Contemporary Additions to Historic Buildings
articles.summary: Adding new floors on top of a historic building presents a challenge beyond accommodating additional space: how can a contemporary intervention respond to the character of an existing structure? Material selection plays an important role in establishing a relationship between different construction periods, whether the aim is to complement the existing building or create a more distinct architectural expression. The LH Residence in Varna , Bulgaria , designed by STARH , offers an example of how fiber cement can help relate a contemporary addition to a historic building.

articles.title: SIP Coffee and Bakery / movs studio
articles.summary: SIP is a coffee and bakery shop in a shopping mall in Almaty , Kazakhstan, designed by MOVS STUDIO. A mall is a place of constant movement, with crowds, music, and bright shopfronts competing for attention, and the studio set out to give visitors a short rest from all of it. The name already holds the idea: a sip is a small, unhurried act, and the interior turns it into a place to slow down.

articles.title: Creasvalley CC Clubhouse / LJL Architects
articles.summary: Even an artificially constructed site can become a landscape as time accumulates. Topography, vegetation, light, and seasonal change establish a distinct order, within which architecture takes its place. The clubhouse is conceived not as an object from which to view its surroundings, but as a mediator through which the site is experienced through terrain, sightlines, and the relationship between inside and outside. The design began by observing this inherent order and exploring how architecture could engage with it.

articles.title: Montana Farm / Estudio Balzano
articles.summary: Montana Farm is a boutique equestrian breeding and training facility located in Buenos Aires, Argentina, dedicated to the selective breeding and high-level training of show jumping horses. The project was conceived to integrate architecture, landscape, and the specific needs of horses within a contemporary equestrian complex, prioritizing animal welfare, functionality, and spatial quality.

articles.title: Relámpago House  / h3o architects
articles.summary: The house, with a gable roof, is characterized by the materialization of lightning as a central element that defines and separates the interior spaces. The lightning, when transformed into a wall and luminaire, clearly and immediately structures and shapes the functioning of the different rooms.

articles.title: Ombria Hotel and Apartments Loulé / PROMONTORIO
articles.summary: Quinta da Ombria is a property in the Algarve hinterland with 150 hectares. Surrounded by extensive citrus groves, fig and carob trees, small farms and villages, the dramatic landscape and the rich biodiversity of this mountainous estate comprise a watercourse and a series of archaeological remnants related to farming and its early waterworks. The resort comprises golf course, hotel and clubhouse, in addition to villas and other residential units.

articles.title: Dunhua Tower / Oyler Wu Collaborative
articles.summary: Rising 17 stories above one of Taipei's principal promenades, Dunhua Tower redefines the residential high-rise typology through a sophisticated interplay of materiality, geometry, and sustainable design. The tower's distinctive L-shaped footprint creates two contrasting facades—one slender and elegantly proportioned, the other broader and more commanding—allowing the building to respond dynamically to its urban context while maximizing natural light and views for residents.
